annotations.title: SAT, ACT and MCAT practice scores

description: Use this when a student wants a score from a published practice test: SAT (College Board digital practice tests 4-11, correct answers per section to score ranges), ACT (practice tests 1-4 and the National test, correct answers per section to scale scores and Composite) or MCAT (four section scores 118-132 to total and AAMC percentile). Returns the score with the source table and fetch date. Not for official score reports, other tests, or predicting a real exam.

practice_test.description: SAT: practice test number 4-11. ACT: 1, 2, 3, 4 or national.

sat_math_correct.description: SAT: correct answers in Math (both modules).

sat_reading_writing_correct.description: SAT: correct answers in Reading and Writing (both modules).
